# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta — Overview

> 16 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta under Overview. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Agents](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/agents.md): Create Agent
- [Deployment Runs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/deployment_runs.md): List Deployment Runs
- [Deployments](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/deployments.md): Create Deployment
- [Dreams](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/dreams.md): Create a Dream
- [Environments](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/environments.md): Include archived environments in the response
- [Files](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/files.md): Upload File
- [Memory Stores](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/memory_stores.md): Human-readable name for the store. Required; 1–255 characters; no control characters.
- [Messages](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/messages.md): Send a structured list of input messages with text and/or image content, and the model will generate the next message in the conversation.
- [Models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/models.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Organization](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization.md): Retrieve information about the organization associated with the authenticated API key.
- [Sessions](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions.md): Create Session
- [Skills](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/skills.md): Create Skill
- [Tunnels](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/tunnels.md): Whether to include archived tunnels in the results. Defaults to false.
- [User Profiles](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/user_profiles.md): Create User Profile
- [Vaults](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/vaults.md): Whether to include archived vaults in the results.
- [Webhooks](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/webhooks.md): Verifies the webhook signature from the `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` headers using your webhook signing key, then parses the payload into an event.
